caseName: Talk America, Inc. v. Michigan Bell Telephone Co.
caseNameFull: Talk America, Incorporated v. Michigan Bell Telephone Company, dba AT&T Michigan Orjiakor Isiogu v. Michigan Bell Telephone Company, dba AT&T Michigan

opinions.text:
Petitions for writs of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit granted. The cases are consolidated and a total of one hour is allotted for oral argument.

Justice Kagan took no part in the consideration or decision of these petitions.

Same cases below, 597 F.3d 370.
